The area where the head meets the front paws is somewhat indistinct. The left front paw seems to merge slightly with the floor shadow or lacks clear definition of toes/claws.
The vertical lines of the wooden structure in the background show slight warping, not perfectly straight, suggesting minor geometric instability.
